[[File:Holo-tree.png|thumb|right|200px|A Holo-Tree]]
'''Life Day Holo-Trees''' were holographic versions of [[Life Day tree/Legends|Life Day trees]]. During one particular [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration, the Life day Holo-Tree was sold along with the [[LD-1 Celebrator|Czerka LD-1 Celebrator]], the [[Life Day Orb/Legends|Life Day orb]], [[Life Day robes/Legends|Life Day robes]] and the [[Life Day Tinsel Bomb]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', December 2012 Life Day celebration</ref>
